name: vault-browse-uncertain
comment: Vault Browse face execution plan, Slice 6 (living tile states) — uncertain + identify-in-place: the Masterpiece/ fixture folder's cleaned title has exactly TWO exact matches in the production offline comics catalogue (gcd_id 206859 and 218321, verified by direct query 2026-08-13), so the certainty gate correctly DECLINES auto-adoption and records the ambiguity durably (VaultIdentifier::recordAmbiguous) instead. This scenario proves the repair path: clicking the uncertain mark opens the EXISTING VaultIdentifyDialog seeded with the group, and choosing any one result settles it through the SAME re-project path (VaultLibrary::identifyGroupWith -> VaultIndex::changed() -> revision bump -> browseAt() re-read), not a bespoke one. Ground-truth finding recorded here: VaultIdentifyDialog is a QtQuick.Controls Popup, and the Popup object's OWN objectName ('vaultIdentifyDialog') is not resolvable through the bridge's item tree (dump-ui confirms its CHILDREN — vaultIdentifyQuery, vaultIdentifyResults, vaultIdentifyRow_N, vaultIdentifyUse_N — ARE reachable, but the Popup wrapper itself is not, matching the ledger's documented 'secondary windows and own-window popups' caution even though this one shares the root window). vaultIdentifyQuery.text is used as the 'dialog opened and seeded' signal instead of the Popup's own visible property. Run with --seed tests/fixtures/vault/browse-states-smoke-seed.
